module: GE extension (core_audio) that loads the game's FMOD banks. On the first update, it scans /art/sound/fmod/<platform> (and the mods subfolder, plus the _headphones folder if headphone mode is enabled), groups the .bank files into bank sets (assets/strings/streams/meta), sorts them (strings first, then 'preload', then by size) and creates an SFXFMODProject per set. It also handles hot-reloading of banks and the FMOD parameter g_GamePause. A modder uses it to register a bank or force a reload.
notes: Bug: in registerBaseBank, the variable is declared `inLevelOrLoadingOrLoading` but tested under the name `inLevelOrLoading` (nil global): the "not during a level or loading" guard never has any effect.

In registerBaseBank, paths are lowercased and prefixed with '/'; before the first load they are remembered in registeredBanks, but the loop that used them (loadBankSets) is commented out: these banks are then never loaded through this list. After init, the bank is loaded immediately via SFXFMODProject.loadBaseBank (only once thanks to loadedBankCache).
Hot reload: onFilesChanged marks any modified .bank bank as not loaded and only triggers triggerBankHotloading when all known banks are marked as not loaded (waits for the end of the rebuild).
The fields M.keepLoadedBanks and M.prevReplayState/M.prevReplayPaused are created dynamically (not declared in the module at load time).
Pause: onPhysicsPaused / onPhysicsUnpaused set the global FMOD parameter g_GamePause to 1 / 0; onReplayStateChanged updates it from simTimeAuthority.getPause().

keepLoadedBanks.desc: Filled by onDeserialized after a Lua reload: if true, onFirstUpdate does not reload the banks.

prevReplayState.desc: Last replay state seen by onReplayStateChanged (created on the fly).

prevReplayPaused.desc: Last 'paused' value seen by onReplayStateChanged (created on the fly).

registerBaseBank.desc: Registers a base FMOD bank (see notes for the behavior before/after initialization).

path.desc: Path of the .bank file, with or without a leading '/' (lowercased)

triggerBankHotloading.desc: Deletes the created FMOD projects, clears the caches, notifies SFXFMODProject (hotloadingTriggered), rescans and reloads all banks then signals completion (hotloadingCompleted).

onFirstUpdate.desc: Hook called on the GE's first update: scans and loads the banks (populateBankSets then loadBankSets), unless keepLoadedBanks is true (Lua reload: nothing is done).

onClientPreStartMission.desc: Hook called before a level starts. Only adds profiler events (level bank loading is commented out).

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of a level. Does nothing (empty body, with a comment).

onPhysicsPaused.desc: Hook called when physics is paused: SFXSystem.setGlobalParameter('g_GamePause', 1).

onPhysicsUnpaused.desc: Hook called when physics resumes: g_GamePause = 0.

onReplayStateChanged.desc: Hook called when the replay state changes: sets g_GamePause according to simTimeAuthority.getPause(), only if state or paused changed since last time.

newState.desc: Table with the fields state and paused

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook before a Lua reload: returns keepLoadedBanks=true, levelProjectsCache and loadedBankCache.

onDeserialized.desc: Restore hook after a Lua reload.

onFilesChanged.desc: Hook called when watched files change: handles hot reloading of .bank files (see notes).

files.desc: List of entries with the filename field (without leading '/')
